meta.description: The frontend stack AwesomeDS assumes in 2026, one pick per layer with the alternatives worth knowing and when each one wins. Picks favour what large, well-designed products ship and what AI coding agents generate reliably. Maintained by hand; reviewed in the weekly research issue.
